"""V-52 in a real browser: the game UI foundation, against the BUILT bundle (web/dist) served by the room.

What breaks without these: a far copy that keeps the testid (a strict locator then finds two nodes and the existing

2026-11-02, item 2: «щас дает тултип основной способности»); an icon sprite that is missing or inserted twice. The
helpers are reached through `window.__aiTableUi` because the build gives chunk exports minified names. Mutants M195-M198.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from tests.browser.test_i2_pointer_board import HttpsCheckpoint, sync_playwright
from tests.implementer.test_i1_password_gate import _free_port

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SPRITE = ROOT / "web" / "src" / "shared" / "ui" / "icons.svg"


@pytest.fixture
def room(tmp_path: Path):
    running = HttpsCheckpoint(_free_port(), tmp_path, {})
    try:
        yield running
    finally:
        running.stop()


def _open(browser: Any, room: HttpsCheckpoint) -> Any:
    page = browser.new_context(ignore_https_errors=True, viewport={"width": 1920, "height": 1080}).new_page()
    page.goto(f"{room.base_url}/table?layout=screen")
    page.wait_for_function("() => window.__aiTableUi !== undefined", timeout=30000)
    return page


def test_v52_the_icon_sprite_is_inserted_once_and_draws(room: HttpsCheckpoint) -> None:
    symbols = SPRITE.read_text(encoding="utf-8").count("<symbol ")
    assert symbols >= 80
    with sync_playwright() as driver:
        browser = driver.chromium.launch()
        page = _open(browser, room)
        assert page.locator("#ui-icon-sprite").count() == 1
        assert page.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('#ui-icon-sprite symbol').length") == symbols
        assert page.evaluate("() => window.__aiTableUi.iconNames().length") == symbols
        page.evaluate("""() => { const host = document.createElement('div'); host.id = 'probe'; host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:0;top:0;color:#fff';
          const svg = window.__aiTableUi.icon('mic'); svg.setAttribute('width', '48'); svg.setAttribute('height', '48'); host.append(svg); document.body.append(host); }""")
